title: centranthus nevadensis subsp. atlanticus
intro: Centranthus nevadensis subsp. atlanticus, commonly known as the Atlantic valerian or red valerian, is a plant species belonging to the valerian family. The Atlantic valerian plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing stress and anxiety, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality. It is believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as sedative, anxiolytic, and spasmolytic effects, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including valerenic acid, valerenol, and valepotriates. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of Centranthus nevadensis subsp. atlanticus for medicinal purposes.
